field_evidence.dataset_title: Assessment of Local Risks supporting the London Safety Plan 2017
field_evidence.ward_level_data_statement: Ward level data is published on the page for the 2017 AoLR in XLS and CSV formats and underpins a postcode look-up tool.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade Assessment of Local Risks supporting the London Safety Plan 2017. The page states that ward-level AoLR 2017 data is published in XLS and CSV formats and underpins a postcode look-up tool. This batch binds verified Campden ward code E05009390 to that unused official ward-level source window; target-row extraction, geometry and parcel join are deferred to local OpenCode.
